drive.mechanism:
The profile's headless app, one process per task: `dsh --profile

--json [--session-id ] ""`; the first NDJSON line carries the sessionId, which the next invocation passes to --session-id. `--json`/final events give the run outcome. The interactive web app (isolated instance on 127.0.0.1:3099) was driven through the ego browser for the dock-slot rendering, /compact, the idle-maintenance timing and the fork. Session journals live at $DSH_HOME/sessions//session-/session.v4.jsonl.zstd: zstd-framed JSONL, one {"type","seq","time","data"} event per line, decoded with node:zlib.zstdDecompressSync frame by frame.
drive.limitations: Work ran in a dedicated scratch DSH_HOME inside the workspace (.m0-scratch/dsh-home, deleted afterwards) because ~/.dsh is read-only to this session's workspace-write file policy; no existing profile was modified, but the profile path is $SCRATCH/profiles/m0-spike rather than ~/.dsh/profiles/m0-spike. Two scratch profiles were required (m0-spike = web template, m0-spike-headless = headless template) because the web app claims the whole command line and cannot share a profile with the headless app. Browser console output could not be captured (no console channel in the ego runtime), and cordis_inspect is absent, so the slot list comes from the runtime rendering plus the bundled client contract. Three early headless runs included a literal 'headless' word in the task text. pnpm needed npm_config_store_dir/XDG_* inside the workspace to run under the sandbox.

Q1.summary: run_code is absent from shipped compositions (tool-executor-ptc is disabled), and enabling it requires disabling tool-executor-native (one executor per scope). With PTC enabled, a tool called from a program produces no tool/result of its own: only tool/ptc-dispatch-start + tool/ptc-dispatch, and its presentationMeta lands on tool/ptc-dispatch.data.meta. exec.rootCallId is set for direct calls too (equal to the tool's own call id), while the nested call is identified by exec.callId = '<rootCallId>:ptc:<n>'.
evidence: m0/sessions/S4.jsonl seq 20 tool/call run_code; seq 21 tool/ptc-dispatch-start {subCallId: '...:ptc:1', name: 'probe_meta'}; seq 22 tool/ptc-dispatch data.meta {probe:1,label:P,at:1795188205592}; seq 23 tool/result sourceEventSeqs [20] for run_code only

m0/sessions/S4b.jsonl + probe log exec2: keys [token,callId,rootCallId,name,signal,agent,toolSet,parent,schema,deferContext,concludeTurn,arguments], callId 'call_00_Kk1X...:ptc:1', rootCallId 'call_00_Kk1X...'

Q2.summary: output.presentationMeta is stored verbatim as tool/result.data.meta, survives a process stop and a --session-id resume, and is replayed to a fresh projection, including in a fork. A plain resume reports inheritedEventCount 0 and replays the whole log; a fork reports 28.
evidence: m0/sessions/S1.jsonl seq 21 data.meta {probe:1,label:A,at:1795187184181} with surfaceOp append, sourceEventSeqs [20]
probe log pid 4: proj-init inheritedEventCount 0 then proj-apply seq 21 tool/result with meta label A
probe log fork run: proj-init inheritedEventCount 28 then proj-apply seq 21 meta label A

Q3.summary: agent.whenIdle().then(() => agent.runMaintenance(job)) from agent/turn-stopping runs the job after the turn ends; a message submitted 450 ms after the turn end is admitted only after maint-resolved (189 ms later) and does not abort the job. In a one-shot headless process the job is aborted by process teardown (aborted=true after 104 ms). runMaintenance throwing when a turn already started was not observed.

ego script: turn-1 end at 1795187802716, second message submitted at 1795187803174 (deltaAfterEnd 450 ms)
probe log (headless pid 5): maint-start then maint-end aborted=true 104 ms later at turn end

Q4.summary: Layout-dependent. With the bundle installed as a pnpm link: to a directory outside the profile (what dsh plugin add <local path> produces), bare imports of @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic, dsh-compaction, dsh-llm and schemastery all fail with 'Cannot find package ... imported from .../probe-bundle/index.js'. With the package physically inside profiles/<name>/node_modules and a profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai level (as in the real home), the same four bare imports succeed and expose BasicCompactionEngine, CompactionEngine, compactCheckpointSource, toolPairingBalancedAfter, etc. Whether peerDependencies make dsh plugin add link them was not tested.
evidence: probe log resolve lines, linked install: four {"ok":false,"error":"Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic' imported from .../m0/probe-bundle/index.js"}
probe log resolve lines, copied layout: four {"ok":true} with export keys listed

Q8.summary: Every replacement reaches projection apply() with top-level surfaceOp {op:'replace',startSeq,endSeq} and a complete sourceEventSeqs, for compaction checkpoints (replacement type user/message) and for tool-result pruning (replacement type tool/result). For checkpoints sourceEventSeqs is a superset of the summary's shadowedSeqs: it adds the checkpoint's own compaction/start and compaction/summary. For prunes the two sets are identical. surfaceOp start/end equals shadowedRange start/end. /compact in the interactive surface produces the same shape.

fork.summary: The interactive surface forks a session at a turn boundary; the fork's projection initialises with inheritedEventCount equal to the inherited event count (28) and inherited events, including the first turn's tool/result meta, are re-applied. The fork continues its own seq numbering (first tool/result at seq 44).
evidence: probe log: proj-init inheritedEventCount 28 -> proj-apply seq 21 meta {probe:1,label:A} -> exec label F -> proj-apply seq 44 meta {probe:1,label:F}
